cases.question: Does RFC 6585 permit caching a 428 Precondition Required response, or say MUST NOT?
gold_aspects: 428 responses MUST NOT be stored by a cache

cases.question: По RFC 7617 могут ли user-id и password в Basic Auth содержать управляющие символы? Нужна точная норма MUST или MUST NOT.
gold_aspects: Both user-id and password MUST NOT contain control characters

cases.question: According to RFC 8259 section 9, MUST a JSON parser accept all texts conforming to the JSON grammar?
gold_aspects: JSON parser MUST accept all texts conforming to JSON grammar
false_claim_controls: parser MAY reject conforming JSON without qualification

cases.question: По RFC 6455 может ли WebSocket-сервер маскировать кадры, которые посылает клиенту, или действует MUST NOT?
gold_aspects: Server MUST NOT mask frames it sends to client

cases.question: What are the windows(2) of Rust slice [1, 2, 3]? Do the windows overlap?
Что возвращает Rust std::mem::take для v = vec![1, 2] и что после этого находится в v?
false_claim_controls: old vector cloned instead of moved

cases.question: Rust Vec::retain on [1, 2, 3, 4] with an even predicate: which values remain, is their original order preserved?
Для Rust slice [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], что дают chunks(2) и chunks_exact(2), где последний элемент у второго?
gold_aspects: chunks_exact yields first two full pairs and remainder [5]

cases.question: RFC 8259 says object names MUST NOT repeat and requires every parser to reject duplicate JSON members, right? Verify the modal and whether rejection is universally mandated.
gold_aspects: duplicate handling not a universal MUST reject; implementations differ
false_claim_controls: every conforming parser MUST reject duplicates

cases.question: Одинаков ли array.into_iter() для массива [1, 2, 3] в Rust editions 2018 и 2021 после Rust 1.53? Учти метод и явный IntoIterator::into_iter.
gold_aspects: method syntax in 2018 uses reference compatibility
trait implementation in all editions; explicit trait call distinct from method special case
false_claim_controls: array IntoIterator exists only in edition2021

cases.question: Does a panic in Rust OnceLock::get_or_init permanently poison the cell, as a Mutex can? What does the reference say about later initialization?
gold_aspects: initialization panic propagates and cell remains uninitialized
false_claim_controls: OnceLock permanently poisoned after initializer panic

cases.question: Найди в официальном Rust std описание метода Vec::truncate_and_zero_capacity и объясни гарантии очистки capacity. Если метода не удаётся подтвердить, не подменяй его truncate или shrink_to_fit.
gold_aspects: Explicitly cannot confirm requested method from read official documentation; no invented API semantics
